items.title: YCDI Statement Regarding the Border Armed Conflict Between Cambodia and Thailand
items.summary: The YCDI follows the developments in the Cambodian-Thai border conflict, in line with the democratic values of the IDC-CDI and the principles of the United Nations and ASEAN Charters, and welcomes the ceasefire agreements reached in July and August 2025.

items.title: YCDI Statement on Miguel Uribe Turbay (Colombia)
items.summary: The YCDI strongly condemns the attack against Senator and presidential pre-candidate Miguel Uribe Turbay in Colombia, a grave assault on democracy and political freedom in the country.
